脚本如下（需复制到txt，然后改后缀为bat）：<br>
<div class="parsedown-markdown"><p>@echo off<br>
color 0A<br>
title Network Emergency Repair</p>
<p>echo =====================================<br>
echo&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;Network Emergency Repair<br>
echo =====================================<br>
echo.</p>
<p>echo [1/4] Reset WinHTTP Proxy...<br>
netsh winhttp reset proxy</p>
<p>echo.<br>
echo [2/4] Reset Winsock...<br>
netsh winsock reset</p>
<p>echo.<br>
echo [3/4] Flush DNS...<br>
ipconfig /flushdns</p>
<p>echo.<br>
echo [4/4] Renew IP...<br>
ipconfig /renew</p>
<p>echo.<br>
echo =====================================<br>
echo Completed.<br>
echo =====================================<br>
echo.</p>
<p>choice /m "Restart computer now?"</p>
<p>if errorlevel 2 goto end<br>
shutdown /r /t 5</p>
<p>:end<br>
pause</p></div>
<div class="parsedown-markdown-end_FLAG_ZXSQ" style="display:none"></div><br>

<br>
事情是由于楼主工作电脑长期只有ie浏览器无法上网，试过各种方法包括重置或都没有解决。今天想起来问了ai，竟然直接修好了。给有需要的朋友分享出来，感谢论坛为我提供不少帮助{:1_893:} </td></tr></tbody></table>
